$comment: Owner-merge paths (docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md §23.1, D50, D61). A pull request that touches one changes the pipeline, code a privileged job runs, or what every later agent obeys: owner-merge.yml labels it owner-merge and turns its auto-merge off, and the owner merges it by hand after reading the diff. `dir/**` is everything under dir; other entries are exact files. Matched without case. Always read from the base branch. `branches` is the release PR's branch (scripts/delivery/lib/release-branch.mjs).
